notes_for_editor: One private PDF (kjackson.us, based on a 2009 visit) carries the 1936 reference, the removal and the remains; the FFLA list says gone. 'Her two sisters' is read as Norway and Angleworm from the article's three-tower list, an inference. The 100 ft figure is the author's 1936 reference, not confirmed as cab height, so height_m is left out. The construction date is unknown. The author's coordinates (N48 02 36.4, W092 16 18.6) agree with the record within about 20 m, so no correction is proposed. The 'public' access level rests on the author's on-foot visit inside the wilderness, not on a source stating public access.
